findings.description: The build command uses -c release/electron-builder.release.yml (the un-substituted template with DEVELOPER_ID_APP_IDENTITY_PLACEHOLDER) instead of release/electron-builder.release.generated.yml produced by scripts/generate-release-config.mjs. The identity substitution is never applied during the actual electron-builder invocation.

testing_summary: Verified diff, script output path, and workflow command; no behavioral tests run per review-phase rules.
risk_rationale: The release workflow generates a substituted config but never consumes it, so the signed/notarized build would use the placeholder identity and fail; this is a concrete reachable failure in the primary release path.
